name: Priya Sharma
headline: Senior Product Manager | Payments · EdTech / learning · Mobile apps
summary: Product manager with 9 years across payments, edtech and retail tech, from analyst to senior PM. At Kestrel Payments I cut checkout drop-off from 38% to 24% and launched subscription billing for 1,200 SMB merchants in 5 months.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Cut checkout drop-off from 38% to 24% by moving to a 2-step UPI and card flow.
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers to rebuild the merchant checkout; payment success rate rose from 91% to 96%.
Launched a subscription billing product for 1,200 SMB merchants in 5 months.
Ran weekly discovery calls with merchants and turned 40+ interviews into a 2-quarter roadmap.
Owned the reconciliation dashboard used by 300 finance users; month-end close went from 6 days to 2.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Grew paid conversion from 2.1% to 3.4% with a free-trial redesign and A/B tests.
Built the mobile learning app (Android and iOS) from 0 to 250,000 monthly active learners.
Replaced a third-party LMS costing ₹4,50,000 a year with an in-house tool.
Worked with 3 engineering squads in Scrum and shipped every 2 weeks.

experience.title: Product Analyst
bullets: Built weekly sales dashboards in SQL and Metabase for 45 store managers.
Found a pricing error worth ₹18 lakh a quarter and helped the team fix it.

projects.name: Kirana Ledger
bullets: Built a no-code bookkeeping app for small shops with Bubble; 150 shops signed up in 3 months.

certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Scrum Alliance, 2021
